sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Naval Academy Award of Degrees Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XII OF 2010
ACT XII OF 2010
PAKISTAN NAVAL ACADEMY (AWARD OF DEGREES) (AMENDMENT) ACT,
2010
An Act further to amend the Pakistan Naval Academy
(Award of Degrees) Ordinance,
1965
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I,
23rd April, 2010]
No.F-9(9)/2010-Legis,
dated 23-4-2010.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 20th April, 2010, and
is hereby published for general information:--
Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the Pakistan
Naval Academy
(Award of Degrees) Ordinance, 1965 (Ordinance No.XX
of 1965) for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the Pakistan Naval Academy (Award of Degrees) (Amendment) Act,
2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

Conferment of degrees on Cadet-entry Officers

ACT XII OF 2010
ACT XII OF 2010
PAKISTAN NAVAL ACADEMY (AWARD OF DEGREES) (AMENDMENT) ACT,
2010
An Act further to amend the Pakistan Naval Academy
(Award of Degrees) Ordinance,
1965
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I,
23rd April, 2010]
No.F-9(9)/2010-Legis,
dated 23-4-2010.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 20th April, 2010, and
is hereby published for general information:--
Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the Pakistan
Naval Academy
(Award of Degrees) Ordinance, 1965 (Ordinance No.XX
of 1965) for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
3. Conferment of
degrees on Cadet-entry Officers.---The
Pakistan Naval Academy shall have the powers to confer the degree of the
Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Arts, abbreviation whereof shall be B.Sc.
(N.A.) or B.A. (N.A.), respectively, and four years Bachelor of Studies in
Naval and Management Sciences, abbreviation whereof shall be B.S. (Naval and
Management Sciences), on any Cadet-entry Officer on his successful completion
of the prescribed course in the Pakistan Naval Academy appropriate to his
branch.".
